Package frc.robot

Interface Constants

public interface Constants
Robot-wide constants.

Deliberately free of hardware detail. CAN IDs, gear ratios, and PID gains are properties of one robot, and this is a library that ships to many. Putting them here would mean every team edits library source to configure their robot, which is exactly what this library is built to avoid.

Where hardware configuration belongs instead

  • A mechanism's physical description — mass, gearing, travel limits, motor model — goes into that mechanism's constants class, which the team constructs and passes in: ArmConstants, ElevatorConstants.
  • Wiring — CAN IDs, limit switch channels, inversion — belongs in the team's own frc.robot.Constants and is passed to the mechanism's constructor. Neither ArmSubsystem nor ElevatorSubsystem reads a hardware ID from anywhere but its own arguments.
  • PID gains — belong to the subsystem that owns the motor controller. The real ArmSubsystem and ElevatorSubsystem carry their starting gains in Constants.HardwareDefaults, and the two simulations in Constants.SimDefaults, precisely because those classes are the thing owning the control loop.

This type is kept as the natural home for genuinely robot-wide, hardware-free values.
